e.title: Python Tutor
e.summary: 代码可视化执行 + AI 帮助：零基础学 Python（rim536 大数据课入门神器）
e.body:
Python Tutor 是在线代码可视化工具：逐行展示 Python 执行过程（变量/内存变化），现已带 AI 帮助。对 RIAA：[[rim536]] 大数据课的零基础 Python 入门——「代码跑起来在内存里发生了什么」一目了然；[[machine-learning-pricing]] 等 ML 主题的代码基础从这起步。

e.summary_en: Visual code execution with AI help: learn Python from zero (on-ramp for the rim536 big-data course)
e.summary_hk: 代碼可視化執行 + AI 幫助：零基礎學 Python（rim536 大數據課入門神器）
e.body_en:
Python Tutor is an online code-visualization tool: step through Python execution (variables/memory changes) line by line, now with AI help. For RIAA: the zero-experience Python on-ramp for the [[rim536]] big-data course — seeing exactly what happens in memory as code runs; the coding foundation for ML topics such as [[machine-learning-pricing]] starts here.
